scripts.ingest:lint: cd ingestion && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.ingest:test: cd ingestion && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.ingest:sample: cd ingestion && uv run python -m ingestion.cli ingest --sample
scripts.ingest:popularity-report: cd ingestion && uv run python -m scripts.report_index_demand
scripts.ingest:debian-pin-popcon: cd ingestion && uv run python -m scripts.pin_debian_popcon
scripts.ingest:debian-benchmark: cd ingestion && uv run python -m scripts.check_debian_archives
scripts.ingest:scale: cd ingestion && uv run python -m scripts.check_scale
scripts.ingest:activate: cd ingestion && uv run python -m ingestion.cli activate
scripts.ingest:run: cd ingestion && uv run python -m ingestion.cli ingest
